name: eduSign
tagline: E-signature service run by Sunet for Swedish universities: upload a PDF or XML file, sign it with your university login, invite others to sign, and validate signed files

vendor_entity.value: Vetenskapsrådet (Swedish Research Council), through its department Sunet

evidence.quote: Sunet, genom Vetenskapsrådet, agerar personuppgiftsbiträde
Vetenskapsrådet, där Sunet är en avdelning

vendor_entity.note: Customers sign the agreement with Sunet; Sunet is not a separate legal entity but a department of the government agency Vetenskapsrådet.

evidence.quote: Personal data controller for the processing of personal data is The Swedish Research Council, Sweden.

parent_company.value: Swedish state (Vetenskapsrådet is a government agency under the Ministry of Education, Utbildningsdepartementet)

evidence.quote: Vetenskapsrådet är en myndighet under Utbildningsdepartementet.
Vetenskapsrådet ansvarar för att Sunet administreras och drivs enligt regeringens fastlagda riktlinjer.

parent_company.note: Not a company group: the operator is a Swedish state agency governed by the government through annual regulation letters (regleringsbrev). No private owner.

evidence.quote: Vetenskapsrådet är en myndighet under Utbildningsdepartementet.

parent_country.note: The owner is the Swedish state, so the same country as the vendor.

evidence.quote: Personal data controller for the processing of personal data is The Swedish Research Council, Sweden.
Hos Vetenskapsrådet finns ett dataskyddsombud som nås via dataskyddsombudet@vr.se

dpo_contact.note: A DPO function with an e-mail and phone number is published; the DPO is not named. The eduSign privacy policy links to vr.se for the DPO contact.

hosting_regions.note: The wiki FAQ says all parts run on Sunet's own servers in a Sunet data centre, but the country or city of that data centre is not named on the eduSign pages, the eduSign privacy policy, sunet.se or edusign.sunet.se. A web search found no eduSign-specific location.

evidence.quote: Uppladdade dokument finns endast i Sunets servrar under den del av processen då signaturen genomförs

local_first.note: Signing happens on Sunet's servers. 'Personal documents' and templates are kept in the user's browser between sessions, but signing still sends the file to Sunet.

eu_residency.note: Content stays on Sunet's own servers during signing, but the location of the Sunet data centre is not stated on the pages checked (see hosting_regions).

evidence.quote: Inga molntjänster används för eduSign
Alla delar av tjänsten körs av Sunet på Sunets egna servrar som är placerade i Sunet datacenter

cloud_providers.note: Authentication through BankID or Freja+ (optional add-on agreement) runs on those providers' servers, which the FAQ says act as sub-processor to Sunet.

transfer_mechanism.note: The eduSign privacy policy says no personal data is transferred to third parties, but no statement about transfers outside the EEA or a transfer mechanism was found, and the data-centre location is not stated.

subprocessors_public.note: No sub-processor list found on sunet.se, the eduSign wiki, the eduSign privacy policy or edusign.sunet.se. The data protection page says a sub-processor may handle some personal data only if the controller signs an add-on agreement; the FAQ names BankID and Freja+ authentication as acting as sub-processor in that case. The privacy policy says: 'No personal data is transferred to third parties.'

subprocessors_count.note: No sub-processor list published (see subprocessors_public). BankID and Freja+ are mentioned only for the optional add-on.

subprocessor_notice.note: No notice process for new sub-processors found; the PUBA that may contain it is not public.

evidence.quote: För att använda eduSign krävs att ett personuppgiftsbiträdesavtal (PUBA) upprättas

dpa.note: The PUBA is signed as part of the agreement with Sunet. No public copy of the template found.

evidence.quote: Sunet, genom Vetenskapsrådet, agerar personuppgiftsbiträde i enlighet med tecknat personuppgiftsbiträdesavtal (PUBA).

role.note: The connected organisation is controller for uploaded content. The separate end-user eduSign privacy policy names the Swedish Research Council as controller for login data and technical logs.

privacy_policy_date.note: No last-updated date shown on the eduSign privacy policy (wiki policy space), the eduSign data protection page or the sunet.se privacy notice.

evidence.quote: Material raderas i och med att signeringsprocessen slutförs samt automatiskt senast trettio (30) dagar efter uppladdning

retention_stated.note: The privacy policy says login logs are kept for troubleshooting and are 'manually purged when it is no longer used', with no time frame.

deletion_on_exit.note: Deletion is stated per document (on completion, or after 30 days at most). No deletion on contract termination described on pages checked.

data_export.note: Users download each signed document (PDF or XML). No admin or bulk export described, and the service does not keep documents after signing.

breach_notice.value: Without undue delay (no hour limit stated)

evidence.quote: Den anslutna organisationen informeras utan onödigt dröjsmål
Tjänsten är utformad för att följa dataskyddsförordningen (GDPR) och tillämplig svensk lag

governing_law.note: Swedish law is the stated legal frame. The contract with a governing-law clause is not public.

evidence.quote: Uppladdat material används för att leverera signeringstjänsten eduSign.

ai_features.note: No AI feature is described on the service page, the FAQs, the wiki, the roadmap or the privacy policy. The service is e-signing and signature validation only.

evidence.quote: Uppladdat material används för att leverera signeringstjänsten eduSign.

ai_providers.note: No AI features (see ai_features), so no model provider. The underlying signing software provider is idsec-solutions (Java integration API linked from the FAQ); the web app is Sunet's own (SUNET/edusign-app).

evidence.quote: Ingen modellträning eller sekundär användning sker.

trains_on_content.note: The same page lists uses that uploaded material is not used for: model training, product development, secondary analysis and other own purposes.

evidence.quote: Uppladdat material används för att leverera signeringstjänsten eduSign.

ai_zero_retention.note: No AI model provider is used (see ai_features).

evidence.quote: Uppladdat material används för att leverera signeringstjänsten eduSign.

ai_admin_off.note: No AI features to turn off (see ai_features).

ai_act_statement.note: No EU AI Act statement found on the eduSign wiki, service page or privacy policy. The service has no AI features.

certifications.note: No ISO, SOC or similar certificate found on sunet.se, the eduSign wiki or the security page. The eIDAS page describes the signature design (advanced electronic signature) and the DIGG framework; these are not certifications.

evidence.quote: Här beskrivs Sunets säkerhetsarbete

trust_page.note: Sunet-wide security page (security work, disclosure contacts). Not an eduSign-specific trust centre.

encryption.note: Encryption in transit or at rest is not described on pages checked. The eIDAS page and FAQ cover one-time signing keys only.

pentest.note: No penetration test statement or summary found on pages checked.

evidence.quote: Sunet tillämpar coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD) kring it-incidenter

vuln_disclosure.note: Sunet states it offers no bug bounty but keeps a security hall of fame. The page says Sunet implements security.txt, but sunet.se, www.sunet.se and edusign.sunet.se /.well-known/security.txt all returned 404.

incidents.note: Web search on 2026-11-17 (eduSign, Sunet, IMY, personuppgiftsincident): nothing found for eduSign. The May 2026 Canvas/Studium incident concerns another service Sunet coordinates and is not linked to eduSign in any source found. Not quoted.

evidence.quote: verify on Sunet statuspage that there are no ongoing issues or planned maintenance

status_page.note: https://status.sunet.se/ covers Sunet services including eduSign.

evidence.quote: SPn begär inloggning med AuthenticationContextClassRef
https://edusign.sunet.se/shibboleth

sso.note: Two Shibboleth SAML service providers; sign-in through the user's home identity provider via Seamless Access. External signers can use eduID; BankID and Freja+ are an add-on.

evidence.quote: Legitimering sker med e-identitet ansluten till SWAMID
ett användarkonto hos en organisation inom eduGAIN federationen (vilket inkluderar SWAMID )

federation.note: Federation metadata itself was not checked; this is Sunet's own statement that users from eduGAIN and SWAMID organisations can log in.

evidence.quote: det skapas med andra ord inga permanenta identiteter i tjänsten

scim.note: No user accounts are stored in the service; access comes from the home identity provider at each login.

evidence.quote: det skapas med andra ord inga permanenta identiteter i tjänsten

mfa.note: No local accounts. MFA depends on the home identity provider; the roadmap lists signing with MFA via local AL3 login as a planned item.

admin_console.note: No institution admin console described. The FAQ says there is no dedicated statistics service; usage can be estimated via GÉANT F-ticks.

audit_logs.note: Technical logs are kept for troubleshooting and security (privacy policy); admin-visible audit logs are not described.

lms_integration.note: No LMS integration described on pages checked.

vpat.note: No VPAT or accessibility conformance report found for eduSign; checked the Sunet accessibility statement and a web search.

evidence.quote: Den här webbplatsen är delvis förenlig med lagen om tillgänglighet till digital offentlig service

wcag_level.note: The statement covers sunet.se only (last updated 13 May 2022), not the edusign.sunet.se signing application.

evidence.quote: Här beskriver vi hur sunet.se uppfyller lagen om tillgänglighet till digital offentlig service

accessibility_statement.note: For sunet.se; no separate statement for edusign.sunet.se found.

hecvat.note: No HECVAT found for eduSign on Sunet pages or the web.

ferpa.note: No FERPA statement on pages checked; this is a Swedish public-sector service.

hipaa_baa.note: No BAA statement found on pages checked.

section_508.note: No Section 508 statement found on pages checked.

state_privacy.note: No US state student privacy agreement found.

uk_gdpr.note: No UK transfer terms found on pages checked.

au_privacy.note: No Australian privacy statement, IRAP or Australian hosting found.

nis2.note: No NIS2 supply-chain statement found. The security page says Sunet reports serious incidents to MSB under MSBFS 2020:8 as part of a state agency, which is not a NIS2 statement.

evidence.quote: Ni tecknar avtal med Sunet om användandet av tjänsten.

free_plan.note: Uploading and inviting others needs a Sunet contract. Anyone who can log in (eduGAIN or a free eduID) can sign documents they are invited to, without a contract.

evidence.quote: Priset är satt i relation till organisationens storlek enligt tabellen nedan.

price_individual.note: No individual price. Organisation prices by full-time-equivalent size: X-Small (under 100 FTE) 840 SEK per month, up to X-Large (4000+ FTE) 8 400 SEK per month.

evidence.quote: Priset är satt i relation till organisationens storlek enligt tabellen nedan.

institutional_licence.note: The organisation signs the agreement; all users in its whitelisted identity provider, staff and students, can then use it.

edu_discount.note: No separate student or academic discount; the service is priced for Sunet-connected organisations by size.

evidence.quote: Priset är satt i relation till organisationens storlek enligt tabellen nedan.

pricing_public.note: The full size-based price table (five tiers, SEK per month) is published. Add-on prices for BankID/Freja+ are not shown.

evidence.quote: eduSign är säkra och enkla e-signaturer för Sunet kunder.

capabilities.note: Also a validation service (validator.edusign.sunet.se) that issues validation certificates for archiving.

evidence.quote: eduSign är säkra och enkla e-signaturer för Sunet kunder.
Själv tjänsten nås via följande URL
English Svenska
Tjänsten kan även integreras med egna system via ett API.

api.note: Java and REST integration API from idsec-solutions, documented at idsec-solutions.github.io/signservice-integration-api. Direct integration needs technical setup agreed with Sunet.

evidence.quote: BSD-2-Clause license

open_source.note: The eduSign web application (SUNET/edusign-app, React frontend and Flask backend) is BSD-2-Clause. The deployment repos (docker-edusign-app, docker-sign-app) show no licence file, and the licence of the signing service itself was not checked.

evidence.quote: Ja det är möjligt men det krävs en del förberedelser

self_host.note: Own instance runs Sunet's Docker images, needs a SAML SP registered in SWAMID, and still needs an agreement with Sunet.
